apartment_number.definition: The number of a flat within its housing company, e.g. B 12; form 7H asks for it.

apartment_number.notes: The form asks for the apartment's number (huoneiston numero, lägenhetens nummer). Form 7H says apartment here although the UI says flat elsewhere (property): the number belongs to the apartment in the housing company, so the Tax Administration's word is kept. The details page's short line names the flat by its number (huoneisto B 12, lägenhet B 12, flat B 12) and is not this term.

basic_improvement.codeNotes: Category value `improvement` (expense; its amount fills no form 7H row as such). For a flat in a housing company that the owner pays: a tenth a year in row 2.5 for 10 years from the year paid, or deducted on sale. For a building (form 7K): added to the undepreciated acquisition cost and depreciated at 4 % a year (residential), or deducted on sale.
basic_improvement.definition: An extension, alteration or modernisation of a flat; not deducted at once, but depreciated or deducted on sale.
basic_improvement.notes: The Swedish is "ombyggnad", not "grundförbättring", which the Tax Administration does not use. "From the year paid" rests on the Tax Administration's worked example (paid in 2025, the first tenth deducted from the 2025 rental income), not on a stated rule; the detailed guidance "Vuokratulojen verotus" was not checked. Work the housing company commissions comes through charges: deductible in the year paid if the capital charges are income-recognised.

Extensions, alterations, modernisations and other similar work done to an apartment or a building are considered improvements.

sources.quote: maksat myyntivoitosta eli luovutusvoitosta veroa.

Capital gains are always taxed as capital income, received the year when the sale was made.

capitalised.definition: Financing charges the housing company has put into a fund for loan repayments: not income for the landlord, but added to the flat's acquisition cost.

capitalised.notes: The code name stays capitalised; the Tax Administration's English says "placed in reserve", never "capitalised".

category.definition: The kind of an income or expense entry, chosen from a fixed list for the entry's type (income or expense); it decides the form 7H row.
category.notes: The Tax Administration doesn't name a classification of entries; the form only has rows. Kategoria is the everyday UI word, chosen over luokka and laji, which are vaguer, and kululaji, which fits expenses only.

charge.definition: A monthly payment the housing company collects from a flat's owner; the general word for the maintenance charge and the financing charge together.

sources.quote: Voit vähentää pääomavastikkeen (rahoitusvastike) vuokratulosta, jos vastikkeet on tuloutettu yhtiön kirjanpidossa.
Du kan dra av kapitalvederlaget (finansieringsvederlaget) från hyresinkomsterna om vederlagen har intäktsförts
If the company collects charges or fees that the company has booked as a balance-sheet reserve, you cannot deduct them.

charge.notes: The general word, used where both charges are meant (Vuokra ja vastikkeet, the charges page). Yhtiövastike / bolagsvederlag (the bank's maintenance_charge notes give it as the housing companies act's general word; not checked against Finlex here) and kuukausivastike / månadsvederlag are accepted by the patterns; the UI uses the shorter vastike / vederlag, as the Tax Administration's pages do. The fi patterns list the forms explicitly because vastik- also starts vastikään (recently); the sv pattern lists the forms so that vederlagsfri (free of charge) doesn't count. Compounds of the specific charges (hoitovastike, rahoitusvastike) are not matched: the patterns need a word boundary before them, and the longer compound terms win where they overlap. Charge in code and in the English UI never covers water charges, although the en pattern also matches water charge(s), charge as a verb and the specific charges; the check runs from the Finnish side, so this only weakens it.

deductible.definition: An expense that can be subtracted from rental income in taxation.
deductible.notes: The Tax Administration's Swedish pages use both "avdragbar" and "avdragsgill" (both on its rental income pages and in its detailed guidance), so the pattern accepts both; the term follows the deductions page.

sources.quote: Kulut ovat vähennyskelpoisia vuokraustoiminnan aloittamisesta lähtien.

deposit.definition: Money the tenant pays at the start of a tenancy as security for the rent and the flat's condition.
deposit.notes: The law's Swedish word is the general "säkerhet" (Act on Residential Leases §8); the Tax Administration and landlords say "hyresgaranti", which is clearer in the UI. The law's English translation says "security"; "deposit" is the everyday British word and the Tax Administration's ("security deposit"). Chosen on purpose over the law's word; a Finland-Swedish reviewer should confirm it.

deposit_return.definition: Paying the deposit back to the tenant after the tenancy ends, in full or with deductions.

document.codeNotes: The table is property_documents; the kinds are lease, financial_statement, charge_notice, minutes and other.
document.definition: A file kept with a flat, such as a lease or a financial statement.

estate.definition: The estate of a deceased person, which can own a flat or a share of one until it is divided.

estate.notes: The Tax Administration's English page titles say "death estate"; its body text and Kotivalo say "estate" or "estate of a deceased person".

expense.definition: Money spent on a flat, such as charges and repairs.

sources.quote: you can claim deductions for the direct expenses of renting.

expense.notes: The Tax Administration says kulut / kostnader for expenses in general and menot / utgifter for capital items (remontin kustannukset … vuosikorjauskuluihin ja perusparannusmenoihin). The UI uses meno / utgift (#32): it pairs with tulo / intäkt and is the Design canvas's word. The year summary (#34) names the form's rows as the form does (Muut kulut / Övriga kostnader). The Finnish and Swedish stay proposed. The category label Muu meno / Övrig utgift fills row 2.5 Muut kulut on purpose: the entry screens keep one pair of words.

financing_charge.definition: A monthly charge the housing company collects for its loan repayments.

sources.quote: Voit vähentää pääomavastikkeen (rahoitusvastike) vuokratulosta, jos vastikkeet on tuloutettu yhtiön kirjanpidossa.
Du kan dra av kapitalvederlaget (finansieringsvederlaget) från hyresinkomsterna om vederlagen har intäktsförts i bolagets bokföring.

financing_charge.notes: The Tax Administration's main word is pääomavastike / kapitalvederlag (also the Limited Liability Housing Companies Act's, 3:3), with rahoitusvastike / finansieringsvederlag in brackets. Kotivalo uses rahoitusvastike, the word on housing company invoices, and the patterns accept both. The Tax Administration's English has no settled term ("capital charges", "capital expenditure charges", "loan charge"), so "financing charge" stays proposed until a fluent reviewer decides; the 7H instructions use both: "capital charges" in the deductions text and "capital expenditure charges" in the label of row 2.3, which the form 7H page quotes; the patterns accept both, and they are the main alternatives. The form 7H page quotes the row 2.3 label as the form has it, so if a reviewer later settles on another English word, keep that pattern and give flat_tax_row_capital_charges an except rather than avoiding the form's wording.

fixed_term.codeNotes: Contract type value `fixed_term` (tenancies.contract_type); its end is tenancies.term_end.
fixed_term.definition: A tenancy agreed to end on a set date; it ends by itself then and usually cannot be ended by notice.

fixed_term.notes: The noun määräaika (the term itself, "määräajan päättymispäivä") is left out of the Finnish pattern; the Swedish messages name it den bestämda tiden or hyrestiden. The English pattern also matches the noun "fixed term", which is harmless because the check runs from the Finnish side.

gross_rental_income.definition: A landlord's rental income before any deductions: the rent and the other payments from the tenant. Form 7H row 2.1 asks for the owner's own share of it.

gross_rental_income.notes: The summary's row 2.1. The Swedish form says "bruttohyresinkomsterna" (definite plural); the term is the stem, and the pattern accepts every form.

housing_company.definition: The limited liability housing company whose shares give the right to occupy a flat.

income.definition: Money a flat brings in, mainly rent.

invitation.notes: The Finnish and Swedish patterns cover the verb too (kutsua, bjuda in), since sentences switch between the noun and the verb.

The Housing Companies Act (1599/2009) says "henkilömäärä" / "antalet personer" when the number of persons is the basis of a charge; the app uses the tenancy's word. The English label is a proposal.

open_ended.definition: A tenancy in force until further notice; it ends by notice, agreement or another legal ground.

ownership.notes: The Swedish patterns include "ägar-" compounds (ägarändring, ägarfördelning), which the owner term also matches; harmless, since a Swedish pattern only has to be present.

personal_identity_code.notes: Not stored in Kotivalo: the form 7H page says to fill it in on MyTax.

principal.codeNotes: Part of a loan payment; not deductible

principal.notes: Not found on the Tax Administration's rental pages in any language; a source is still needed.

except.sharing_remove_dialog_text: The flat is named by its address.

property.notes: The Act on Residential Leases says asuinhuoneisto / bostadslägenhet / residential apartment; the UI uses the everyday asunto / bostad / flat.

receipt.definition: A photo or PDF of a receipt, kept with an expense.

recurring_amount.codeNotes: Rent and charges over time, as validity periods
recurring_amount.definition: A rent or charge that repeats every month and changes only from a given date.

rent.definition: What the tenant pays the landlord for the flat, usually monthly.

sources.quote: Vuokratuloa ovat vuokran lisäksi muut maksut, joita saat vuokralaiselta
Hyresinkomst är utöver hyran också andra avgifter som du får av hyresgästen
In addition to rent, rental income also covers all other payments you get from your tenant

rent_payment.definition: One payment of rent received for a month of a tenancy, recorded with its amount and payment date; a month may have several. Gross rent is taxed in the year it is received.

sources.quote: vuokranantajan haltuun vuokranmaksun ja huoneiston hyvän hoidon turvaamiseksi
Hyresgästen har rätt att få befrielse från hyresbetalningen eller skälig nedsättning av hyran
som säkerhet för hyresbetalningen och god skötsel av lägenheten
unless the tenant later fails to make their rent payments and you need to keep the deposited money.

rent_payment.notes: Derived, not verified: the sources use the words for paying rent as the tenant's obligation (a deposit securing the rent payment), while Kotivalo records each payment received. The Finnish law says "vuokran maksaminen" (chapter 4) and uses vuokranmaksu- in compounds such as vuokranmaksukausi and vuokranmaksupäivä; the match patterns list the endings so those compounds don't count as this term. A payment on its own (maksu, betalning, payment) is a generic word. Recording a payment uses the app's verb for recording (kirjata, registrera, record).

rental_income.definition: Rent and other payments a landlord gets from renting out a flat; taxed as capital income.

sources.quote: Vuokratulot ovat pääomatuloa ja niitä verotetaan pääomatuloveroprosentin mukaan.
Hyresinkomsterna är kapitalinkomster och beskattas enligt kapitalinkomstskattesatsen.
In addition to rent, rental income also covers all other payments you get from your tenant

share.codeNotes: Basis points (5000 = 50 %), per ownership_periods row; shares add up to exactly 10000
share.definition: An owner's part of a flat in per cent.

sharing.definition: Giving other people access to a flat by invitation.

tax_year.definition: The calendar year whose income and expenses a tax return covers.

sources.quote: Ilmoita myös verovuosi eli se vuosi, jolta ilmoitat vuokratuloja.
Ange också skatteåret, dvs. det år för vilket du deklarerar hyresinkomster.
Report also the tax year, i.e. the year during which the reported rental income was earned.

tenancy.definition: A lease between a landlord and a tenant for a flat, open-ended or fixed-term.

sources.quote: Jos vuokralainen kuolee, vuokrasuhde pysyy voimassa entisin ehdoin
förblir hyresförhållandet i kraft på de tidigare villkoren

tenancy.notes: The unofficial English translation of the Act on Residential Leases says "lease" or "lease relationship", never "tenancy". "Tenancy" is the everyday British word for the relationship; the agreement itself is a "lease agreement" (vuokrasopimus, hyresavtal). The law's fixed-term and open-ended leases are "määräaikainen" / "tidsbestämt" and "toistaiseksi voimassa oleva" / "gäller tills vidare".

tenant.definition: A person who rents a flat.

sources.quote: kun aloitat aktiivisesti etsiä vuokralaista asuntoon
från den tidpunkt då du aktivt börjar leta efter hyresgäst till bostaden
the start date for tax purposes is the date when you begin an active search for a tenant

tenant.notes: The Tax Administration's Swedish detailed guidance also uses "hyrestagare"; "hyresgäst" is the law's word and the more common one.

tenant_fee.codeNotes: Tables `tenant_fees` and `tenant_fee_amounts`: what the tenant pays the landlord on top of the rent (water, parking, sauna, other), as validity periods inside a tenancy. Form 7H row 2.1 (rental income). Not linked to the usage charges.
tenant_fee.definition: A payment the tenant makes to the landlord on top of the rent, such as for water or a parking space. Rental income, not part of the rent.

sources.quote: Vuokratuloa ovat vuokran lisäksi muut maksut, joita saat vuokralaiselta – esimerkiksi vesimaksu tai autopaikan vuokra.
är utöver hyran också andra avgifter som du får av hyresgästen – till exempel vattenavgift och hyra för bilplats.

en.term: fee on top of the rent

sources.quote: In addition to rent, rental income also covers all other payments you get from your tenant

tenant_fee.notes: The Tax Administration describes the concept ("muut maksut, joita saat vuokralaiselta") without a fixed term; the words are built from its description. Keep apart from the usage charge (käyttömaksu), which the housing company bills the owner. The Act on Residential Leases (481/1995) calls such charges "käyttökorvaus" / "användningsbaserad ersättning"; the app follows the Tax Administration's "maksut vuokran lisäksi" because parking rent is not a usage-based compensation and "käyttökorvaus" sits next to the housing company's käyttömaksu. Open question for the owner: bare "maksu" in the fee messages can also be read as a rent payment.

transaction.codeNotes: income or expense. Not to be confused with a database transaction
transaction.definition: One logged income or expense with its amount, date and flat.

usage_charge.codeNotes: Tables `usage_charges` and `usage_charge_amounts`: monthly charges the housing company bills the owner besides the maintenance and financing charges (water, parking, sauna, other), as validity periods from the first of a month. Not linked to the tenant fees. Water: form 7H row 2.2; the others row 2.5 (to verify, #16).
usage_charge.definition: A monthly charge the housing company bills the owner for using something, such as water per person, a parking space or a sauna slot, apart from the maintenance and financing charges.

sources.quote: kun osakkeenomistajan maksuvelvollisuus perustuu sopimukseen, joka koskee tiettyä kiinteistön tai rakennuksen käyttöön liittyvää käyttömaksua
en aktieägares betalningsskyldighet grundar sig på ett avtal som gäller en viss bruksavgift för användningen av fastigheten eller byggnaden

usage_charge.notes: The Limited Liability Housing Companies Act (1599/2009, ch. 3 s. 1) uses käyttömaksu / bruksavgift for a charge for using the property agreed by contract, apart from the company charge (vastike / bolagsvederlag); housing company price lists also say käyttökorvaus. A water charge billed monthly by the housing company is recorded as a usage charge of the kind water; one-off water bills stay entries (water_charge). In English, "usage charges" sit next to "charges" (vastikkeet) but are not a kind of them. The English word is a proposal. In the Act the word covers a charge agreed by contract; a per-person water charge set in the articles of association is a vastike under the same Act, and the Tax Administration groups it with the maintenance charge (7H row 2.2). The app deliberately records the housing company's monthly per-person water charge as a usage charge of the kind water, which keeps row 2.2.

validity_period.definition: The dates from which, and until which, a time-bound fact holds: rent, charges, shares, tenancies.

water_charge.definition: Water charges: paid by the landlord to the housing company (deductible, form 7H row 2.2 with the maintenance charges), or paid by the tenant to the landlord (rental income).

sources.quote: 2.2 Hoitovastikkeet ja vesimaksut / vuosi (ilmoita vain oma osuutesi)
Vuokratuloa ovat vuokran lisäksi muut maksut, joita saat vuokralaiselta – esimerkiksi vesimaksu tai autopaikan vuokra.
2.2 Skötselvederlag och vattenavgifter/år (ange endast din egen andel)
är utöver hyran också andra avgifter som du får av hyresgästen – till exempel vattenavgift och hyra för bilplats.
2.2 Maintenance charges and water charges per year (report only your share of the charges)

water_charge.codeNotes: Category values `water_charge` (expense, paid to the housing company, row 2.2) and `tenant_water_charge` (income, paid by the tenant, row 2.1).
water_charge.notes: One word, two senses: the labels tell them apart (to the housing company / from the tenant). The Tax Administration's English pages also say "money towards a water bill" for the tenant's payment; the 7H form's "water charges" is used for both. A water charge billed monthly by the housing company is a usage charge of the kind water (usage_charge); one-off water bills are entries.

year_summary.definition: A flat's income and expenses for a year, split by owner, as the figures for each owner's tax return.

except.pdf_file_stem: A file name: lower case with no ring, as the slug rule writes it (kotivalo-arssammandrag).
A file name: words joined by a hyphen (kotivalo-year-summary).
